turns.user: ok so a few things, I'm starving today so I think I need more carbs, what should I have before training tomorrow morning, and is it fine that I skipped the stretching at the end yesterday
turns.reply:
Carbs are exactly what we want to pull on when hunger spikes like that, Ashley. Since you're starving today, let's make sure you're eating enough of them to fuel up. 

For your pre-workout tomorrow morning, you want something fast-digesting so it's ready to use by the time you train, without sitting heavy in your stomach. Since your profile has a nut-free filter active, a great option is:

**Banana & Honey Oatmeal**
- 50g rolled oats (cooked in water or a nut-free milk like soy or oat milk)
- 1 medium banana, sliced
- 1 tbsp honey

This gives you a great mix of fast and moderate-releasing carbs to power through that lower body session tomorrow. If you want me to put this into your breakfast slot for tomorrow, just say the word and I'll add it to your plan.

As for skipping the stretching yesterday — don't sweat it at all. Post-workout stretching is great for cooling down and relaxing, but it isn't going to make or break your recovery or your progress. The most important thing yesterday was getting that bench press session done. 

How are your legs feeling today? We've got back squats and Romanian deadlifts on the schedule for tomorrow morning.
